name: smoke-e5
description: Pipeline test of the native run (E5), never used for results: probe pass, then E5 for ML-DSA-44, ML-KEM-768, Falcon-512, SLH-DSA-SHA2-128f, HQC-1, ECDSA P-256 and DHKEM(X25519), tiny budgets (fast: 10 warm-up + 200 samples; slow: 1 s and at least 3 samples), 1 repetition. Started with scripts/native-mac.sh.
